text_block_list.text: Symboli Kris S is even quieter than usual today.
choice_data_list: Are you okay? Are you nervous?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I was remembering—my last race.
Reconfirming... the cause of my defeat.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
This time, for sure—I will fulfill my duty.
—Without fail.
